symptom: A skipped successful workflow could activate or satisfy the hourly gate, and rerunning its only green could erase activation. Finished PR checks retained an older green canary result, while a newer run in progress blocked cloud PRs before its outcome existed.
rule: Count executed product and receipt-upload steps, retain activation across attempts, and evaluate the newest completed run or attempt while a newer run is in progress. Refresh the required exact-head status and recheck completion-based freshness after asynchronous reads. Noncloud lanes only alert; the exact reviewed incident repair is the only cloud exception.
